We aim to prove Theorem 2 by induction n. Clearly it is enough to show Theorem 2 for all induced subgraphs of Au. The base cases are when n ≤ 7, which are easily verified. For the inductive step, suppose n ≥ 8 and Au[S] is an n-vertex subgraph of Au with e edges. Additionally, suppose Au[S] has the maximum number of edges out of all n-vertex subgraphs of Au. The inductive hypothesis is that all n'-vertex subgraphs of Au, where 3 ≤ n' < n, have at most e(n') edges.
